It deploys no contract of ours: a Prime is configuration on the existing contracts below (Safe proxies, Zodiac Roles proxies, two OpenZeppelin TimelockController instances per gate, one for moves and one for recovery). Each address was read back on Base Sepolia on 27 October 2026 (code present). The reference line runs the same design one transaction at a time; its record below is the run on Base Sepolia of 27 October 2026. The custody run of 29 September 2026 (custody at a plain address) is kept as a record of that run. No mainnet deployment exists.

leverageYield.status: fork-verified against the live contracts and run live on Base Sepolia on 28 October 2026 (open, close and a batch of refusals, each read back on a second RPC)
leverageYield.note: the config-only leverage-yield execution adapter for the tokenised-gold carry flow: a Zodiac Roles policy template on the custody gate plus a Safe MultiSend batch, no contract of Prime's. It adds no production contract, no wasm and no build-hashes.json entry. The gate registers the Roles MultiSend unwrapper for MultiSendCallOnly, so one batch is split and each inner call checked against the leverage-yield role, then the custody Safe runs the batch atomically.
leverageYield.result: 2 of 2 tests, Safe 1.4.1 and Safe 1.5.0, 31 checks each: the open runs atomically (supply gold + borrow stable + deposit yield), the borrow cap bounds the leverage, Aave's health factor still applies, the close runs atomically (redeem + repay-max + withdraw-max), and every out-of-scope call is refused with its Roles status
